task: Fix a build break introduced by dependabot's sha2 0.10.9 -> 0.11.0 bump (PR #77) so it can merge

events.summary: Scoped to the single format! call site broken by the sha2 0.11 digest type change; no hashing behavior, dependency other than the one dependabot already bumped, or unrelated code touched

CI on PR #77 failed the verify job: 'error[E0277]: the trait bound Array<u8, ...>: LowerHex is not satisfied' at services/artifact_manifest.rs's format!("{:x}", hasher.finalize()) after the sha2 0.11.0 bump changed the digest output type

Replaced format!("{:x}", hasher.finalize()) in services/artifact_manifest.rs::sha256_file with a manual byte-to-hex loop, matching the pattern already used in commands/agent_execution_security.rs::sha256_hex, so no new dependency (e.g. hex crate) was introduced

cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml artifact_manifest: 4 passed, including writes_sorted_manifest_with_sha256_and_excludes_itself which asserts an exact sha256 hex string, proving the manual hex encoding produces byte-identical output to the pre-bump format!("{:x}") path

cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml clean (sha2 0.11.0 compiles); make verify: full Rust test suite passed, clippy -D warnings clean, tsc --noEmit clean, design lint clean, web build clean
events.scope: src-tauri crate, full make verify gate

events.summary: Dependency bump build break fixed and verified; PR #77 can now merge
